name: Erik
source:
The fourth prince of the Fasan Kingdom. The Witch's Curse makes him transform into a rabbit. His mental age is about half of what his appearance makes him look, and the stuffed frog he carries with him at all times is his only friend. Although he's not very useful in combat, he excels with arts such as music or drawing. Since the magic wore off, he always follows his favourite brother Lucia.

[From [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/]Official site[/url]]
